<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Remove the current green block and move player to initial position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Current greens: {len(greens)}")

# Remove the green
for g in greens:
    gc = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
    gr = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
    center_r = (min(gr) + max(gr)) // 2
    center_c = (min(gc) + max(gc)) // 2
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done')
    print(f"Removed green: done={done}")
    if done:
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break

# Move player to initial position (cols 20-21)
if not done:
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    pc = [p[1] for p in player['boundary']]
    print(f"Player cols: {min(pc)}-{max(pc)}")
    
    # Move LEFT until at cols 20-21
    while min(pc) > 20:
        result = action(['LEFT'])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
        pc = [p[1] for p in player['boundary']]
        done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done')
        print(f"LEFT: player cols={min(pc)}-{max(pc)}, done={done}")
        if done:
            print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
            break
        if min(pc) <= 15:
            # Can't move further left, break
            break
    
    # If at cols 20-21 with 0 greens, check
    if not done and min(pc) == 20:
        print(f"At initial position with 0 greens, done={done}")
        # Try pressing ACTION7
        result = action(['ACTION7'])
        done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done')
        print(f"ACTION7: done={done}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
